reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the original clause is one-way against us (Licensee), runs three years post-termination and covers every employee of Licensor and its Affiliates, exceeding the walk-away limits (>24 months, all Vendor personnel).

The redline lands precisely on the playbook fallback: mutual obligation, scope limited to individuals directly involved in performance, 12 months measured from the end of that involvement, and the pre-existing general-advertising / unsolicited-inquiry carve-out is preserved verbatim; no no-hire language was introduced.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.634 changed-character ratio) is explained by the rule itself requiring three simultaneous changes (duration, scope, mutuality) in a single sentence; the carve-out sentence and defined term 'Solicit' are left untouched, so the edit is as small as the position allows.
Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, uses the required prefix and first-person-plural tone, and does not misstate the original clause.
